transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because my eating has gotten kind of out of hand. Sometimes I eat too much, and then I… I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I don’t gain weight. I know that probably sounds bad. I’ve been trying to handle it, but it’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t really stop.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Um… I don’t do it after every time I eat, but… for at least the last three months, I don’t think there’s really been a week where it didn’t happen at least once. Usually it’s late at night, after I’ve eaten too much, and then I go make myself throw up.

Some weeks it’s more than once… several times, I guess, especially when I’m home more because of my back. I know that’s not good.
How often do you find yourself eating a very large amount of food in one sitting, more than most people would eat in the same amount of time?

It happens mostly at night… after everyone’s gone quiet. I’ll go stand in the kitchen and just kind of pick at things, but then it turns into a lot more than that. Leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream… whatever’s there.

I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but sometimes I look around and it’s like half the pantry’s been picked over, and I know that’s more than a normal meal.
How often do these nighttime eating episodes happen—do you experience them once a week, multiple times a week, or almost every day?

Um… I’d like to say it’s just once a week, but that wouldn’t really be honest. For at least the last three months, there’s hardly been a week where it hasn’t happened.

Some weeks it’s several times, especially if I’m home more because of my back. It’s usually late at night, and then afterward I go make myself throw up. I’m sorry… I know that’s not a good answer.
When you have these nighttime eating episodes, do you feel like you can’t control how much you’re eating or stop yourself from eating even if you wanted to?

Yeah… I mean, I try to tell myself I’m just having a snack or I can stop after this one thing, but once it starts on those nights, it doesn’t really feel like I’m the one steering anymore.

It’s like my hands just keep grabbing food even while I’m thinking, “Lucy, knock it off, just stop.” And I don’t feel like I’m back in charge until it’s already over. I know that probably sounds bad… but that’s what it feels like.
When you make yourself throw up after eating, is it mainly because you're trying to keep from gaining weight or because you feel you've eaten too much and need to 'undo' it?

I guess… it’s both, but if I’m being really honest, it’s mostly because I’m scared I’ll gain weight after I’ve eaten that much.

I tell myself I’m just “undoing it,” like I can make it not count, and then I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. I know that probably sounds awful. It’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop doing it, even when I promise myself I won’t.
Do you make yourself throw up even when you haven’t eaten that much, just because you’re worried about gaining weight or feeling like you need to 'undo' what you’ve eaten?

Mostly it’s after I feel like I ate too much… that’s when I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I won’t gain weight.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but… it has gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop doing it. Like even when I tell myself I don’t need to “undo” it, I still end up doing it.
When you make yourself throw up, do you feel like you're trying to prevent yourself from becoming fat, even if you don’t know exactly how much weight you’ve gained or might gain?

Yeah… I think that’s what it is. I don’t always know what it would actually do to my weight, like I can’t say I’ve gained anything right then, but in my head it feels like if I don’t get rid of it, I’m going to get fat.

I know that sounds kind of… dramatic maybe, but that’s why I end up in the bathroom making myself throw up after I’ve eaten too much. I’m scared of gaining weight, and it’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop doing it.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after eating even just a small amount of food, because you were worried about gaining weight or feeling like you needed to 'undo' it?

I don’t think it’s usually after just a small amount… at least, not that I want to make it sound like that.

It’s more when I feel like I’ve eaten too much, then I get scared I’m going to gain weight, and I end up going to the bathroom and making myself throw up. I know it’s not a good answer, but that’s the pattern. And it’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop once that thought gets in my head.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after eating even when you weren’t sure you ate too much, just because you were worried about your weight or how your body looks?

Sometimes I’m not totally sure if it was “too much,” if that makes sense. I just get this panicky feeling that it was too much and that I’m going to gain weight or look worse, and then I end up in the bathroom making myself throw up.

I don’t want to make it sound like I’m doing it for no reason… it’s more like once that worry starts, I feel like I have to undo it. And honestly, it’s gotten to where I’m scared I can’t stop.

Do you usually make yourself throw up only after you've had one of these nighttime eating episodes where you feel like you ate a lot, or do you sometimes do it even when you haven't eaten much, just because you're worried about your weight?

It’s mostly after those times when I feel like I’ve eaten too much… like I get overwhelmed and then I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it keeps happening, and honestly that’s why I’m here. It feels like once I think I need to get rid of it, I’m scared I can’t stop myself.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after eating even when you didn’t eat a large amount, just because you were worried about gaining weight or how your body looks?

I mean… not usually if it’s really not much. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m doing that all the time.

It’s more after I feel like I’ve eaten too much, then I get scared about gaining weight, and I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. That’s kind of why I’m here, honestly… because it keeps happening, and I’m scared I can’t stop once I get that thought in my head.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after eating even when you didn’t feel like you ate a large amount, just because you were worried about gaining weight or how your body looks?

I don’t think it’s usually when I truly haven’t eaten much… I mean, I don’t want to answer wrong.

It’s more that after I eat what feels like too much, I panic about gaining weight, and I end up making myself throw up in the bathroom. That’s really why I’m here, because it keeps happening and I’m scared I can’t stop once I get that thought in my head.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after eating even when you didn’t feel like you ate a large amount, just because you were worried about gaining weight or how your body looks?

I… I think what I’m trying to say is it’s usually after I feel like I ate too much. Then I get really scared I’m going to gain weight, and I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up.

I’m not trying to make excuses or make it sound better than it is… it’s just gotten to where it keeps happening, and I’m scared I can’t stop once I start thinking I need to do it.
Have you ever made yourself throw up after eating even a small or normal amount of food because you were worried about gaining weight or how your body looks?

I… I don’t want to overstate it. It’s mostly after I feel like I’ve eaten too much, and then I get scared I’m going to gain weight. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up.

That’s really why I’m here. It keeps happening, and I’m scared I can’t stop once I get it in my head that I need to do it.
